name: Gotov na vsjo
source:
The Semyon of that time had long since stopped trying to escape the endless 7-day cycle of returning to "Sovyonok". He enjoyed each new week spent with the girls, without whom he could no longer imagine life. The mischievous and funny Ulyana, the romantic but moody Lena, the rude but fragile Alisa, the smiling and affectionate Slavya, and the talkative and clumsy Miku.

An Everlasting summer filled with boundless happiness... But at one point, it all ended. Leaving the camp and, as usual, having fallen asleep once again in the "Ikarus", Semyon woke up right in Olga Dmitrievna's house. Going outside, he found the camp empty. The electricity was working properly, there was food in the kitchen of the canteen.

At first, Semyon did not think much of it, assuming that the system had failed and he had ended up in the camp before the start of the shift. But the days went by, and the camp remained empty. Semyon got nervous. Attempts to get out of the "Sovyonok", as always, led to nothing. And then the first "rupture" of space, as Semyon later began to call it, appeared. Exhausted by the uncertainty, our pseudo-pioneer went in there without any hesitation and found himself at some abandoned construction site. Semyon shook his head in bewilderment and went to find out where he had ended up. This is where the first death of a heroine that he's witnessed occurred...
translation:
那时的谢苗早已不再试图逃避返回“索维诺克”的无休止的7天循环。他很享受与女孩们一起度过的新的一周，没有她们，他无法想象生活。调皮搞笑的乌里安娜、浪漫但喜怒无常的莉娜、粗鲁但脆弱的阿丽莎、微笑深情的斯拉维亚、健谈笨拙的米库。

一个充满无限幸福的永恒的夏天……但在某一时刻，这一切都结束了。离开营地，像往常一样，谢苗在“伊卡洛斯”号上再次睡着，醒来时就在奥尔加·德米特里耶夫娜的家里。走出去，他发现营地空无一人。供电正常，食堂厨房里有饭菜。

起初，谢苗并没有多想，认为系统出现了故障，他在轮班开始前就进入了营地。但日子一天天过去，营地依然空无一人。谢苗很紧张。一如既往，逃离“索维诺克”的尝试没有结果。然后，正如谢苗后来所说的那样，第一次空间“破裂”出现了。由于不确定性而疲惫不堪，我们的伪先驱毫不犹豫地走进去，发现自己身处一个废弃的建筑工地。谢苗困惑地摇摇头，去找寻自己到底去了哪里。这是他亲眼目睹的第一起女英雄死亡的地方……
